newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-SAUBER TO UNVEIL NEW FORMULA ONE CAR ON INTERNET.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-SAUBER TO UNVEIL NEW FORMULA ONE CAR ON INTERNET.

text.p: Swiss Formula One team Sauber said on Wednesday they would unveil their 1997 car on the Internet.

Journalists will be able to interview drivers Briton Johnny Herbert and Italian Nicola Larini and have a preview of the car on the worldwide web on February 10, just before it is tested for the first time at Fiorano in Italy.
